name: Built-in rules
_about: The rules the ledger ships with: the 2014 classes (SRD features plus short summaries), subclass names, the SRD races, background, feat, armor and weapons, and the few subclasses and items the original ledger supported. Text is short original summaries. Generated; see docs/data-formats.md.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.sum: Insult a creature that can hear you. On a failed Wisdom save it takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.sum: Create a sound or the image of an object no bigger than a 5-ft cube. A creature that studies it can make an Investigation check against your spell DC; touching the image shows it's fake.

spells.name: Blade Ward
spells.sum: Until the end of your next turn you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapon attacks.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.sum: Whisper a discordant melody only one creature hears. On a failed Wisdom save it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must use its reaction, if it has one, to move as far away from you as it can. On a success it takes half and doesn't move. Deafened creatures succeed automatically.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.sum: A creature you can see regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.sum: Every creature in a 20-ft cube makes a Dexterity save or is outlined in light. Attack rolls against outlined creatures have advantage, and they can't benefit from being invisible.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.sum: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action in a sentence or two to a creature that can hear and understand you. On a failed Wisdom save it follows it. Ends early if you or your allies damage it.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.sum: A creature you touch, and what it wears and carries, turns invisible until the spell ends or the target attacks or casts a spell.
spells.up: One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.sum: Read the surface thoughts of a creature within 30 ft. As an action you can probe deeper: on a failed Wisdom save you learn its reasoning, emotions and something on its mind.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.sum: You and chosen creatures within 30 ft get +10 to Stealth checks and can't be tracked except by magic.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.sum: Mark a creature. Your weapon hits on it deal an extra 1d6 damage, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. If it drops to 0 HP, use a bonus action on a later turn to move the mark.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.sum: Change how you look, including clothes and gear. You can seem up to 1 ft shorter or taller. An Investigation check against your spell DC sees through it.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.sum: A rope up to 60 ft long rises and its top opens into a hidden extradimensional space that holds up to eight Medium or smaller creatures.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.sum: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.sum: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, resist that damage type until your next turn starts, and your first melee hit on your next turn adds 1d6 of that type.

spells.name: Fear
spells.sum: Creatures in a 30-ft cone make a Wisdom save or drop what they hold and become frightened, dashing away from you.

bless.text: Bless: add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.
